protocol: Nested CV: inner stratified 3-fold for all scaling, feature selection and hyperparameter search. Harmonisation is fit ONLY on each outer-train fold (combat/zscore); combat_trans is the labelled transductive exception (batch-only fit on all data, no labels). Pooled scheme: outer stratified 5-fold (seed 42). LOSO scheme: each fold holds out one whole source.
baseline: round-2 unharmonised pooled numbers reused from metrics_pooled.json (same splits, same grids)

harmonisation.note: ComBat fit on all data for the deployment artifact; CV estimates used train-only fits
ComBat fit on all data for the deployment artifact; CV estimates used train-only fits

harmonisation_artifact.note: Classifier pickles are fitted on harmonised features; the fit file holds the batch parameters needed to harmonise a new scan. transform() needs diagnosis, age and sex — for a new scan use the healthy reference level for diagnosis (see script header). Unseen batches are left uncorrected (identity).

deployment_note: No round-3 model is a deployment candidate. Best LOSO balanced accuracy is 0.536 (ComBat SVM, AUC 0.503) and best pooled is 0.585 (ComBat LR) — both at or near chance once the site is unseen. The live service keeps its existing weights; the weights decision from round 2 stays open.
